Script:


BELL POTTINGER

V/O: The People’s March on the 7th of April saw a quarter of a million South Africans take to the streets in a nationwide protest calling for President Zuma to step down, and an end to state capture. His decision to fire Finance Minister Pravin Gordhan and Deputy Minister Mcebisi Jonas had quickly resulted in South Africa’s downgrade to junk status. That day a large crowd also gathered outside the Gupta family compound, calling for them to leave the country. Five days later a united front of opposition parties marched to the Union Buildings demanding the demise of the Gupta empire. Despite having employed one of the world’s biggest Public Relations firms, their popularity is at an all-time low.
Bell Pottinger were hired to rebuild the Gupta’s reputation but if anything their reputation lies in ruins.

Link: Banks have closed their account, the JSE canceled a number of Oakbay trades and there are growing calls for their South African citizenship and residency to be revoked; their home here in Saxonwold looks more like an armed fortress. As far as PR campaigns go, it’s been an unmitigated disaster.

V/O: Ever since the Guptas landed a private plane at Waterkloof Airforce Base, there’s been an outcry over their relationship with Number One. But when Zuma disastrously fired former Finance Minister Nhlanhla Nene, it became painfully apparent just how influential the Guptas are.

Peter: The Guptas had offered Jonas R600 million to become Finance Minister for them. He himself put out a statement confirming that, and if that was the point of Bell Pottinger coming into the picture you can understand why. They were in big trouble.

V/O: Peter Bruce is the former Editor of Business Day, and has closely followed the Bell Pottinger story.

Peter: Bell Pottinger can put stories into newspapers that can influence journalists. It will talk for you in areas where you can’t talk. And the Guptas are fantastically bad communicators. They don’t speak very good English, in fact, barely speak English at all.

Ajay: Everybody meet with the ministers and this thing, they are right. And if Guptas meet with the minsters and anybody they are wrong. Why? Is there anything, I don’t know that you are to be make it out. What’s the reason that Guptas is being target, or family is being target?

Peter: They decided they needed some help, and when you need that sort of help you probably turn to a company like Bell Pottinger.

V/O: Bell Pottinger was founded by Lord Tim Bell, described as Margaret Thatcher’s PR guru. He devised a strategy that helped her become Prime Minister of Great Britain. They now have offices in London, the Middle East and Asia, and provide services to big corporations, political parties and governments.

Solly: We are quite convinced that the Guptas have been running a parallel state system, and our President has been made a decoy of their activities, in fact he has effectively become a proxy president on behalf of the Guptas, and they tried to clean the image of the Guptas.

V/O: Deputy Secretary-General Solly Mapaila says an anonymous report was leaked to the South African Communist Party by unknown sources. It claims that Gupta-owned Oakbay Investments contracted Bell Pottinger for a flat fee of a hundred thousand pounds a month. Managing the account was 33-year-old Victoria Geoghegan, who previously worked on both the Investec and Richemont accounts. Her father is former British Aerospace executive, Chris Geoghegan.

Peter: As you know British Aerospace was one of the big companies involved in the first Arms Deal into South Africa. During that process he would have come across a guy who we know was involved in the Arms Deal called Fana Hlongwana, and they became friends.

V/O: Fana Hlongwane is a close associate of both Zuma and the Guptas, and allegedly introduced them to Bell Pottinger in Dubai. According to the report Bell Pottinger’s campaign used a series of underhand tactics to divert the public outcry against state capture.

Peter: They created the White Monopoly Capital thing and various versions of it. It’s to distract, and it’s nice because it’s South Africa and you’ve got to have a bit of race in there. Let’s not forget that the ANC does fancy itself as a left-wing organization, so it’s nice you’ve got “monopoly” and ‘capital” in there. It just doesn’t describe anything real on the ground.

V/O: The most visible target of this campaign was Chairman of Richemont Johann Rupert. On social media the Chancellor of Stellenbosch University started being referred to as the Stellenbosch Mafia King.

Link: Johan Rupert was one of the first people to openly criticize President Jacob Zuma. As a result he’s become a target for pro- Zuma lobby groups – that’s included framing him as the face of white monopoly capital and an enemy of economic transformation.

V/O: Professor Richard Calland believes this is nothing but a re-branding exercise.

John: Richard, you called Bell Pottinger, the architects of South Africa’s dangerous populist branding, what did you mean by that exactly?

Richard: Well it’s become clear that over the last year, the populist message calling for so called radical economic transformation has become a much sharper brand, it has become articulated in a much more pointed fashion. It’s got what I call its twin ugly sister - white monopoly capital, and what I see the Gupta-inspired and Gupta-paid for campaign is all about is simply seizing power and wealth for a small number of people at the expense of many millions.

V/O: And Mapaila believes this campaign has been embraced by President Zuma.

Solly: It’s been Bell Pottinger that have been providing strategic PR relations to make them look good, to create an impression that he is for Radical Economic Transformation. He is not for it, in fact his radical economic transformation is about the Guptas.

John: So the plan is to replace one sort of monopoly capital with another?

Solly: That is their sense of Radical Economic Transformation: change the white face of the economy, put the black face of the economy; not change the conditions of the workers, or the conditions of the economy for the majority.

Link: Part of the assault on so-called white monopoly capital as punted by Bell Pottinger is the notion that white people control the Johannesburg stock exchange and that black people only owned 3%. But according to the JSE’s own figures, around 23% of the country’s top 100 companies is owned by black people and white people control around 22%.

Peter: At least 40% of the JSE is owned by people who don’t live in South Africa.

V/O: The remaining 10% is not assessable by race, as the campaign seeks to do.

Peter: It has a very particular purpose: it’s there to demonize a certain group of people, or certain kind of money; but the money required for radical economic transformation is what it’s always been: foreign.

V/O: The Bell Pottinger campaign allegedly used social media, and a series of fake bloggers, commentators and Twitter users to manipulate public opinion. An investigation by the Daily Maverick exposed over a hundred of these fake Twitter profiles and demonstrated how the sequence of tweets was computerized and tweeted to the exact second. They all spread the same message:
The State of Capture report was baseless and rubbish;
The media and Thuli Madonsela were themselves captured and biased;
The real enemies are white monopoly capital and specifically, the Ruperts.
V/O: Bell Pottinger have consistently denied creating these fake Twitter accounts. But it wouldn’t be the first time they’ve produced fake media, according to former employee Martin Wells.

Martin: I was employed to work for them in a war zone.

V/O: In 2006 he was employed by Bell Pottinger to edit videos on a military base in Baghdad.

Martin: All I was told is that I would be working on news items and that was it. And then when I arrived, I discovered it was anything but that.

V/O: He ended up making pro-American video clips posing as real news on Arabic channels. This so-called news wasn’t produced by real journalists, but he says, by Bell Pottinger on behalf of the US government.

Martin: We would get material in, we would turn it around with English voice over on it and then we would send it up the command line up to the White House and back down again, and then we’d get any changes we needed to make, or anything to the voice we needed to change we would change.

John: So, in effect you were producing propaganda films?

Martin: Because we worked with the US intelligence services and we were working with the psi ops and psychological operations units, so yeah, it’s obviously propaganda.

Peter: So they do practice Dark Digital Arts, whether they created all these foul Twitter accounts, I have no idea.
Link: We sent Bell Pottinger three separate requests to respond to the allegations contained in the anonymous report published by the SACP. They declined to appear on camera and instead sent us a statement in which they describe the report as being wholly untrue.
V/O: The Report also alleges that organizations like Black First Land First were used to promote the Bell Pottinger campaign.
23:27:45
Peter: They were very quick the other day to rush to the Saxonwold compound to ward off the threat posed by all the Saxonwold housewives standing holding placards. So, we can clearly see whose interests they are there to defend. They are directly linked to the Gupta family; I’m sure they’re paid by the Gupta family.

V/O: We called the President of Black First Land First, Andile Mngxitama to ask for an interview.

Andile: I regard you as hostile media.

John: Why is that Andile?

Andile: Because it’s part of White Monopoly Capital which you are part of. By the way that thing you work for is owned by Rupert; so they are our enemy.

John: Would it change your mind if I said we are not owned by the Ruperts?

Andile: No, I know he has shares in that shit, I know.

John: And what about the allegations that you are being paid by the Guptas - or were set up by Bell Pottinger – because these are the allegations?

Andile: I don’t trust you guys, you are part of the propaganda machine of white capital, you are hostile territory that’s what it is, but you are running a fucked-up story which has no basis whatsoever.

V/O: Bell Pottinger have resigned as Oakbay’s communications advisers, claiming there is a concerted social media campaign against their firm. Last weekend a small protest was held outside their London offices.

Richard: Bell Potinger was becoming the story and I think that probably gave them a level of discomfiture. In the longer term, what would be the reputational hit for them of being associated with such a dodgy campaign and one that to some people’s minds was interfering with the political sovereignty of another country.

Link: Ostensibly Bell Pottinger was hired by Oakbay rather than the Gupta’s to manage their public relations, they’ve consistently denied orchestrating the white monopoly capital campaign, setting up fake Twitter accounts and stoking racial tension. The question is, if that’s true, what did Bell Pottinger do? We’ve asked Oakbay for an interview but they’ve chosen not to respond.

V/O: Eventually they issued a statement confirming the termination of their relationship, and denying all the allegations.

Text: We confirm the termination of our relationship with Bell Pottinger (BP), amicably parting ways.
We deny the further rebarbative allegations. BP has issued a comprehensive statement to which we cannot add any further.

Peter: They have contributed now to the downgrading of a once quite well-functioning democracy in Africa. That is not something you want to be seen to have been part of, but they have unquestionably contributed to the crisis that we are in. BP arrives in your country, you get downgraded, and they leave. I don’t know how they spin that, but I’m sure there is a way to spin it through the next client they get, but God help Venezuela or Peru or whoever they end up advising next.

So, we can clearly see whose interests they are there to defend. They are directly linked to the Gupta family; I’m sure they’re paid by the Gupta family. V/O: We called the President of Black First Land First, Andile Mngxitama to ask for an interview. Andile: I regard you as hostile media. John: Why is that Andile? Andile: Because it’s part of White Monopoly Capital which you are part of. By the way that thing you work for is owned by Rupert; so they are our enemy. John: Would it change your mind if I said we are not owned by the Ruperts? Andile: No, I know he has shares in that shit, I know. John: And what about the allegations that you are being paid by the Guptas - or were set up by Bell Pottinger – because these are the allegations? Andile: I don’t trust you guys, you are part of the propaganda machine of white capital, you are hostile territory that’s what it is, but you are running a fucked-up story which has no basis whatsoever. V/O: Bell Pottinger have resigned as Oakbay’s communications advisers, claiming there is a concerted social media campaign against their firm. Last weekend a small protest was held outside their London offices. Richard: Bell Potinger was becoming the story and I think that probably gave them a level of discomfiture. In the longer term, what would be the reputational hit for them of being associated with such a dodgy campaign and one that to some people’s minds was interfering with the political sovereignty of another country. Link: Ostensibly Bell Pottinger was hired by Oakbay rather than the Gupta’s to manage their public relations, they’ve consistently denied orchestrating the white monopoly capital campaign, setting up fake Twitter accounts and stoking racial tension. The question is, if that’s true, what did Bell Pottinger do? We’ve asked Oakbay for an interview but they’ve chosen not to respond. V/O: Eventually they issued a statement confirming the termination of their relationship, and denying all the allegations. Text: We confirm the termination of our relationship with Bell Pottinger (BP), amicably parting ways. We deny the further rebarbative allegations. BP has issued a comprehensive statement to which we cannot add any further. Peter: They have contributed now to the downgrading of a once quite well-functioning democracy in Africa. That is not something you want to be seen to have been part of, but they have unquestionably contributed to the crisis that we are in. BP arrives in your country, you get downgraded, and they leave. I don’t know how they spin that, but I’m sure there is a way to spin it through the next client they get, but God help Venezuela or Peru or whoever they end up advising next.
